t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Start off by picking a random colour for the first few go's and see which colour gives you the most mushrooms. You'll be able to tell in a few go's. This continues for the majority of the game but keep an eye out as sometimes the colour which gives you the most may change.

vb_textbox.text: Each pair of colours has one that will give you more mushrooms. Start off the first few turns by picking random colours, and you will gradually get a feel of "x" gives more mushrooms than "y". There are four pairs in total, and the sequence is the same throughout the pairs. For example, if you find red, green, brown and blue give more mushrooms, it'll be the same sequencing throughout the game. Be careful though as it can change to the other colour at any point, so you will need to remember the opposite sequence for the pairs when this happens.
